story_type: aircraft carrier tests firefighting foam across its flight deck
hook: This aircraft carrier buried its own flight deck in foam.
narration: This aircraft carrier buried its own flight deck in foam.
It was the USS Abraham Lincoln, at sea in the Pacific on April 7, 2021.
Sailors were testing the ship's firefighting foam system during sea trials.
Water alone can spread a jet fuel fire, because the fuel floats. This foam lays a film over the fuel and cuts off the air the fire needs.
On a ship that carries fueled jets and bombs, it has to cover the deck fast.
Soon the crew was walking through a white-out in the middle of the ocean.
outcome: The Lincoln's sailors finished the test standing in foam across the flight deck.
title: Carrier buries its flight deck in foam
description:
On April 7, 2021, sailors aboard the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN 72) tested the ship's aqueous film forming foam systems on the flight deck while underway for sea trials in the Pacific Ocean.

Footage: U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist Seaman Lake Fultz, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/805043
